exceptions.reason: A request in the upstream's own format passes through unchanged (the plan's same-format passthrough). Today's core rewrites it: it adds model and default safetySettings that turn every filter off, renames functionDeclarations to function_declarations, parameters to parametersJsonSchema and responseSchema to responseJsonSchema, fills in empty functionResponse names, and replaces a thoughtSignature it does not recognise as one Gemini issued (as with this case's synthetic signature) with skip_thought_signature_validator, which throws that reasoning state away. The new core keeps every thought signature on the part it came with, unchecked.
